'''Awlsten''' is an [[Asha'man]] with the rank of Asha'man.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Awlsten}}

== Activities ==
Awlsten fought in [[Maradon]] under [[Rodel Ituralde]]'s command. He again fights for him, this time at [[Shayol Ghul]]. Ituralde gets him to give the signal when their forces are to engage the [[Trolloc]] army.

Atop the pass leading into [[Thakan'dar]], he signaled the [[Aiel]] to roll boulders and burning logs down on to the [[Shadowspawn]].
